findings.anchor: def handle(root, story, environ, start_response, read_json, respond):
evidence: Creates a fresh child directory, inserts identity, registers internal folder, calls save then activate. ProjectTests new-child tests exercise these branches.
Called by New for external parent and by save/open for final child. Canonical registered projects retain existing ownership exception.
Recognizes newly registered canonical folder only through live ledger identity; reused by validate_folder and open_project.
New checkpoints and output defaults use the child folder, not its parent. Legacy exact-folder API callers remain supported.
Reopens the named child without creating another identity; new backend test saves source and verifies restoration.
Returns projects_folder to ProjectController and the registered child folder after activate.
Sends parent_folder only for New; saves outgoing memory/checkpoint, installs returned child path. Browser creation and project-switch tests pass.

findings.anchor: def project_root(root: Path, workspace_id: str) -> Path:
evidence: Reads project-folders registry; save, output/media ownership and current/open consume the same stable identity. Existing round-trip and named-child tests pass.
Called by save and successful project operations; derives outputs beneath the returned child. Child outputs directory checked by backend test; per-tool provider execution not run.
